notes: From 0.7.93 a MoE model that does not fit gets --moe-cache auto by itself with --fit, so
--fit's own split, which these points measure beside the cache and --cpu-moe, is asked
for as --moe-cache off; until 0.7.92 it was no flag at all (r-next21 and before).
Large MoE models on ONE GCD, their experts in the node's 512 GB of RAM, against c02's
all-GPU splits of the same files (moe-235b-q4-split4, moe-480b, moe-671b on 8 GCDs,
gpt-oss-120b on 2): what a single 64 GB GPU beside a large RAM serves, objective (5).
Three ways to keep the experts in RAM, as extra_args:
--moe-cache auto  the experts pinned in RAM, the most used cached in VRAM, misses copied
over the CPU-GPU link (llama.cpp PR #29887 and patches 0001-0004; on
ROCm from the engine of 14-10-2026, next11);
--cpu-moe         every expert computed by the CPU, the rest on the GPU;
(none)            what --fit chooses by itself: the experts of the last layers in RAM.
Exclusive: one point a node, for its RAM. cores 'reserved': the server runs on the 56
cores of the whole node, not the 7 of its GCD, since the CPU computes experts.
No --fit-strict: these loads do not fit the GPU by design.
DeepSeek-V3.1 (378 GiB) is the boundary: its experts may be more than the RAM can pin.
Same batches as the c02 groups they are compared with; prompt groups: one 8,000-token
prompt (nominal), the reading speed that the prefetch of patch 0003 is for.
ram-stats (added 15-10-2026, runner 7): the cache's step statistics in the server log
(LLAMA_MOE_CACHE_STATS=64: time to the routers, in the cache, copies and their rate, the
share of experts found in VRAM), for why the cache wins with one request and loses with 32.
evict (added 15-10-2026, an engine with llama.cpp patch 0008): the eviction that keeps the
slots filled early in a step when the step wants more experts than the cache holds, against
the least recently used one (LLAMA_MOE_CACHE_EVICT=lru), same statistics; the new eviction's
points also write the experts every layer selected (LLAMA_MOE_CACHE_TRACE, a file per point
beside its server log, runner 8), for bench/moe_cache_sim to replay the policies on real
routing. Plan the group alone: GROUP=evict.
evict2 (added 16-10-2026, an engine with patch 0009): the decaying counts of 0009 against
0008's eviction (LLAMA_MOE_CACHE_EVICT=pass) in the same binary, three repeats, since the
replay gives them 1-4 points of experts in VRAM apart, about as much as one repeat's noise.
Plan the group alone: GROUP=evict2.

groups.name: ram-default
notes: No flag: the expert cache by itself where 25-85% of the experts do not fit
(MOE_CACHE_DEFAULT_OUT), --fit's split elsewhere. The log says the share and
which way the load went: the 235B and the 480B should take the cache, gpt-oss-120b
and DeepSeek-V3.1 the split, at the tokens/s ram-* measured each way.
